2760-4279-6634.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-6634.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-6634.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

69-539-3172-5475.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-3172-5475.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-3172-5475.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

141-3085-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-5686.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

728-1202-2158-3249.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1202-2158-3249.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

3756-4050-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

1920-2060-4222-5328-7741.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-4222-5328-7741.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

1628-2292-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1628-2292-3490-7426.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Berta triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

677-4217-5211-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
677-4217-5211-6798.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Lutri.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
677-4217-5211-6798.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

2302-2773-3490-4369-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2302-2773-3490-4369-5231.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature, adding {R}.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

3817-3967-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-2842-5170-6132.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

5256-5310-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
5256-5310-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1322-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1322-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1879-2366-3688-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1879-2366-3688-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2457-4289-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2661-3692-4924.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

1339-2438-6713.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
1339-2438-6713.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3443-3464-3657.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
3443-3464-3657.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3443-3464-3657.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

222-527-2438-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3470-5720-5721-6620.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
3470-5720-5721-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.
3470-5720-5721-6620.notes: If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Lotus Cobra's trigger.

478-804-2821-3789-4249.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3789-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
478-804-2821-3789-4249.description:
Animate Candelabra using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

970-1369-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
You have a way to remove Asmodeus from the battlefield.
970-1369-4067.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Asmodeus's activated abilities until end of turn.
Remove Asmodeus from the battlefield.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Asmodeus's first ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Repeat from step 5 two additional times.
Repeat from step 4.

1365-2292-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2292-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

4447-4691-5076.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Vilis.
You control a red permanent.
4447-4691-5076.description:
At the beginning of an opponent's upkeep, Assault Suit triggers, giving them control of Vilis.
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Kederekt Parasite triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library or by having a life total of 0.
When the opponent loses the game, you regain control of Vilis.
Repeat from step 1 for each remaining opponent.

317-4186-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
317-4186-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1110-4186-5017.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
1110-4186-5017.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.

2481-2790.notablePrerequisites:
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block and kill Angel of Destiny.
Your life total is at least 11 greater than your starting life total plus an additional 2 life for each opponent beyond the first.
You have no more than three opponents.
2481-2790.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Angel of Destiny.
Angel of Destiny's first ability triggers, causing you and the opponent to gain life equal to the damage dealt.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Seize the Day by paying {3}{R}, untapping Angel of Destiny and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time, attacking a different opponent.
Cast Seize the Day from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}, untapping Angel of Destiny and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time, attacking a different opponent.
At the beginning of your end step, Angel of Destiny triggers, causing each opponent it attacked this turn to lose the game.

148-1029-1742-4410.notablePrerequisites:
Hermetic Study and Keen Sense attached to Tolarian Kraken.
Tolarian Kraken does not have summoning sickness.
148-1029-1742-4410.description:
Activate Tolarian Kraken by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap it.
Repeat.

628-4053-4284.description:
Cast Clone by paying {3}{U}, having it enter as a copy of Mikaeus.
Choose to have Clone put into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clone dies, triggering its undying ability, returning itself to the battlefield with no +1/+1 counters due to Solemnity, as a copy of Mikaeus.
Repeat from step 2.

1135-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1135-4658.description:
Cast Kazuul's Fury by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, dealing damage equal to Soul of Eternity's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1308-1684-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1308-1684-2178-4050.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {R}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

2493-3617-4428.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2736-3473.manaNeeded: {W}{U}{R} per opponent with 20 or more life
2736-3473.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted for {W}{U}{R} to donate Transcendence to someone above 19 life.
That player loses the game, then control of Transcendence reverts to you.
Repeat to cause all opponent with 20 or more life to lose the game.
